verdict.rationale: Shopify's B2B page says merchants can "sell to businesses and consumers from one platform" with buyer self-serve and "all the B2B features you need," which supports B2B alongside DTC. However, the evidence never names the specific mechanics in the story. Markets pricing previews cover regional pricing, not customer-specific pricing. Missing for 10: customer-specific price lists, volume/quantity pricing, quotes or draft orders, net-terms invoicing, plan or tier availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
